categories.definition: Legacy one-step holdout: single fit, horizon 1, observed lags.
Historical recursive multi-horizon backtest: refit at every origin with data through that origin only; horizons 1-30 from the model's own recursion.
Future projection: beyond the data, no observed outcome.

label: HISTORICAL BACKTEST: rolling-origin re-forecasts of past days from a frozen data snapshot, refitted at every origin with data through that origin only and scored against the recorded actuals. Not prospective validation.
legacy_headline_note: The legacy 4.93 % MAPE is a one-step-ahead (h = 1) score with observed lags on one 90-day block (2026-04-02..2026-06-30), from a single fit. It is a different procedure from the recursive forecasts evaluated here; only the legacy-holdout comparison window puts the two side by side on the same target days.

models.description: Last observed value: yhat(o+h) = y(o) for every horizon.
Horizon-correct seasonal naive: yhat(o+h) = y(o + h - m*ceil(h/m)), the most recent observed day one or more whole seasons before the target.
Mean of the 4 most recent observed values on the target's weekday (on or before the origin).
Median of the 5 most recent observed values on the target's weekday (on or before the origin).
Additive seasonal exponential smoothing ETS(A,N,A), weekly season, smoothing parameters chosen from a fixed grid by in-sample one-step squared error.

Faithful legacy notebook regression: 32 collinear features, minimum-norm least squares with intercept (scikit-learn LinearRegression semantics), recursive 30-day procedure with clip-at-0 and integer rounding before feedback.
Modernised regression atlas-m2-regression-v1: 18 non-collinear M1 features plus intercept, OLS on standardised columns (full rank required), recursive, clipped at 0.

selection.reason: atlas_linear_regression beats the best baseline same_weekday_median_5w by at least 3 % in MAE and the selection-period DM test is significant at 0.05.
selection.rule: Pre-registered: candidates ['naive', 'seasonal_naive', 'same_weekday_mean_4w', 'same_weekday_median_5w', 'seasonal_exponential_smoothing', 'atlas_linear_regression']; selection period development; MAE over horizons 1..30 on forecasts common to all eligible candidates; failure rate above 0 makes a candidate ineligible; the best regression is selected only if its MAE is at least 3 % below the best baseline's and the DM test (conservative p) is below 0.05; otherwise the best baseline.

sensitivity.description: Target days covered by a warning-level M1 data-quality flag removed.
sensitivity.label: exclude_flagged_targets

sensitivity.description: Origins whose legacy design is affected by the leap-day step: trend, year and day of year are exactly collinear until 2025-01-01 (2025 targets not estimable from December 2024 origins), and afterwards the step is identified from very few 2025 rows (high leverage).
sensitivity.label: legacy_identification_boundary

sensitivity.description: Targets on a federal holiday, its observed day, or the day before or after.
sensitivity.label: holiday_related_targets

sensitivity.description: Only targets reachable at every horizon, so all horizons share one set of days.
sensitivity.label: target_aligned
